title: Megurine Luka — Greetings Are Idol 101〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see us perform today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy this next song♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Luka's been outstanding lately.
And the audience is really loving what she's doing.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Not only that, she's getting the others to perform better as well...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It might be time for our next show to center more around Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Bye, everyone!
See you at our next show♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Today's show was off the hook.
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really was! And we all did so well!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Especially Luka!
Your singing and dancing were on point!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. You led everyone so well and gave the show a huge influx of energy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate the compliments.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
That was an incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO. Those new dance routines you came up with really did the trick.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They made things so easy because of how I was able to move more freely than usual.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
I decided to come up with a couple new ones that allowed you to use more of the stage after seeing you practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'm sure you're tired. We don't have any shows for a little while, so please take this opportunity to get some rest.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is our schedule that open?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We have some meetings and preparations for upcoming shows, but we're relatively free for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Then, let's do our best to make our next show another good one♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, what meetings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
For producing merchandise.
We've received quite a few ideas from everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And we're gonna decide what to make based on their ideas? That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad you're looking forward to it. We've been given many wonderful ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to those meetings now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. But if we don't have any shows...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I might be able to sneak in a visit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, that should be it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you for helping me clean up.
By the way, is there something that you're hiding from me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, you know me all too well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You said that we wouldn't have any shows for the time being, so I thought that I could go on a little trip tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A trip? Sure, that seems fine...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of trips, Minori said something about visiting a zoo...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
So that's what you were planning, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you mind?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, you go and have fun since you have the time to for a change.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you, KAITO.
I was hoping that we could all go together, but I'm afraid that we'd cause her too much trouble if we went over as a group.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's okay. However, in return for keeping this a secret, I'll be expecting your next show to be superb.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
I promise to put on an even better performance than the one I put on today♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll be looking forward to that.
A few ideas popped into my head while watching you today, so I'd like to work those in next time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, have a safe trip.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Thank goodness KAITO's okay with my plan.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And I can't help but wonder what sorts of animals will be at the zoo.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to having a fun day off♪
